headline: Invesco and ICICI Prudential launch new funds for silver and power sectors
hook: New fund offers across commodities and power
summary: Invesco Mutual Fund and ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund have announced new fund offerings targeting the silver and power sectors. These investment options allow retail participants to gain focused exposure to industrial metals and India's growing electricity demand. Investors can evaluate these thematic funds based on their risk appetite and portfolio diversification needs.
why_it_matters: New sectoral funds offer thematic exposure options for retail investors.
